ArtifactRef.description: Pointer to a large object held by an ArtifactStore (never inlined into events).

uri.description: object location, e.g. file://… or s3://bucket/key
uri.title: Uri

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

domain.description: enum or entity set of a symbolic value; required when ambiguous
domain.title: Domain

index.description: entity sets / enums indexing the table
index.title: Index

CostTerm.description:
One additive cost term of an objective level.

- action_cost: `weight` × the declared `cost` of every action taken on the path.
- state_rate: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on every post-state s_1..s_k of the path.
- terminal: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on the final state s_k of the path.
CostTerm.title: CostTerm

set.description: name of a declared entity set
set.title: Set

Extension.description: Namespaced, versioned extension payload. `schema_id` names the JSON Schema that validates `data`.
Extension.title: Extension

IRPayload.description: Model in the neutral finite-state IR (profile deterministic_finite_v1).
IRPayload.title: IRPayload

features.description: semantic features the model relies on beyond the profile (e.g. 'probabilistic_effects'); unsupported features make engines answer UNSUPPORTED
features.title: Features

origin.description: where the source came from (path, editor, import)
origin.title: Origin

parent_version.description: version this one was edited from
parent_version.title: Parent Version

NamespacedPayload.description:
Model in a profile-specific format owned by a semantic-driver plugin. `schema_id` names the JSON Schema
(published in the driver's descriptor `input_schema`) that validates `data`.
NamespacedPayload.title: NamespacedPayload

ObjectiveDecl.description: A named cost objective declared by the model: the sum of its terms over a path.
ObjectiveDecl.title: ObjectiveDecl

QuantExpr.description:
forall/exists → bool, count → number of satisfying members, sum → sum of an int body,
max_over/min_over → largest/smallest int body over the satisfying members (`default` when there is none).

default.description: max_over/min_over only: value when no member qualifies
default.title: Default

domain.description: entity set or enum to range over
domain.title: Domain

QuantExpr.title: QuantExpr

RefExpr.description: Reads an action parameter or a quantifier-bound variable.
RefExpr.title: RefExpr

observable.description: false: never revealed to agents directly
observable.title: Observable

ValueTable.description: Values of an indexed location family: `default` everywhere, overridden by `cells`.
ValueTable.title: ValueTable

VarExpr.description: Reads a state variable or a constant table at the given index.
VarExpr.title: VarExpr

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical payload (IR: of the canonical IR, as in v1)

extensions.description: namespaced extension slots; keys are reverse-DNS namespaces, formal-lab.core.* is reserved
extensions.title: Extensions
